name: Heroes' Feast

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a gem-encrusted bowl worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

targets.description: up to twelve creatures who eat the feast

summary: A magical feast that hardens up to twelve diners for the next day.
text: Eating takes an hour. For 24 hours afterwards each diner has Resistance to Poison damage, immunity to the Poisoned and Frightened conditions, and a Hit Point maximum raised by 2d10, gaining that many Hit Points too.
